name: Circuit Ghost Wrap
description: A look built for moving unseen through the Shelf's surveillance gaps and contested corridors. The base is a close-fitting long-sleeve in matte black moisture-wicking jersey, worn thin at the elbows, with a dead neural port interface sewn into the left collar — salvaged from a discarded BCI unit, non-functional but kept as a ward or trophy. Over it hangs a deconstructed puffer vest, the insulation long since redistributed unevenly so it sits flat in some panels and bunched in others, creating an unintentionally textured silhouette. The outer shell of the vest is coated in a peeling anti-reflective treatment that still works in low light. Slim straight-leg trousers in dark grey ripstop are belted with a length of doubled industrial webbing, the buckle a salvaged cargo clip. Three patch pockets run down the right thigh, each sealed with hook-and-loop closures worn almost to smoothness. Feet are wrapped in thin compression socks under low-profile sneakers with thick gum soles — the uppers re-glued at least twice, the toe cap reinforced with a strip of adhesive rubber. A long rectangular scarf in faded indigo cotton, washed to near-grey, is wound once around the neck and tucked into the vest. The hood of a destroyed jacket — just the hood, separated from its original garment — is clipped to the back collar of the vest with two carabiners, deployable in seconds.
functionality: Anti-reflective vest coating reduces visibility under surveillance lighting. Detachable hood provides rapid head coverage without a full jacket. Low-profile footwear for silence on metal grating. Hook-and-loop pockets allow fast access. Salvaged BCI port in collar is non-functional but can fool a casual scanner into misreading the wearer as an augmented individual, which sometimes grants different treatment at checkpoints.
what_it_says: Movement is this person's primary skill. They don't want to be remembered, don't want to be scanned, don't want to be stopped. The dead BCI port is either a bluff or a reminder of something lost. Either way, they've built their whole look around not being noticed — and the fact that it works is a kind of expertise.
worn_by: scavengers who work inside corporate perimeters
people evading debt collectors or bounty contracts
manufacturer: Self-assembled; vest shell possibly Circuit-brand surplus
story_hooks: The salvaged BCI port collar piece actually retains a fragment of its previous owner's neural signature — and a corporate security system just flagged it as belonging to a missing employee.
The detachable hood was cut from a jacket belonging to someone who died in the wearer's arms, and they've never explained why they kept it.
The anti-reflective coating on the vest is failing — and there's one section of the Shelf where the wearer needs to pass through a motion-sensitive killzone tonight.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately fragmented, low-profile silhouette built for surveillance evasion and rapid movement. The look reads as intentionally broken-in and self-maintained — someone who assembles function from discarded parts. Slim and angular, with strategic bulk only where it serves concealment or insulation. The overall impression is ghost-like: minimal reflectance, neutral tones, designed to slip through crowds and camera dead zones.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tight through the torso and arms; slim-straight through the legs. The deconstructed puffer vest hangs loosely over the fitted base layer, creating visual noise and silhouette distortion. Everything is calibrated for mobility — no excess fabric, no billowing, nothing to catch or snag.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte black moisture-wicking jersey (base layer); peeling anti-reflective coated nylon (vest shell); dark grey ripstop cotton-poly blend (trousers); faded indigo cotton (scarf); compression blend synthetics (socks); vulcanized rubber and re-glued canvas (sneakers)
physical_description.texture: Worn smooth and matte where fabric has thinned; visible pilling and stress creases; uneven puffing in the vest creates raised quilted patches alternating with flat, deflated sections; peeling anti-reflective coating shows silvered underlayers; hook-and-loop closures worn to near-silk; scuffed and scavenged aesthetic throughout
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black, charcoal grey, and faded indigo as primary palette. Anti-reflective coating creates subtle silver-grey shimmer in low light. Neutral, desaturated — nothing to draw attention in dim corridors or surveillance feeds.
physical_description.closures: Industrial webbing belt with salvaged cargo clip buckle; hook-and-loop on all three thigh pockets (worn smooth); carabiners clipping hood to collar; friction-fit and re-glued construction on sneakers
distinctive_features: Non-functional salvaged BCI neural port interface sewn into left collar — worn as talisman or trophy
Deconstructed puffer vest with unevenly redistributed insulation creating textured, disrupted silhouette
Peeling anti-reflective coating on vest shell — still functional in low light, deliberately left un-restored
Three hook-and-loop sealed patch pockets running down right thigh, worn to smoothness from repeated use
Deployable hood (separated from original jacket) clipped to back collar with carabiners — seconds-to-deploy coverage
Doubled industrial webbing belt, salvaged cargo clip buckle
Faded indigo scarf wound once around neck, tucked into vest for quick-release access
Sneakers with re-glued uppers (at least twice) and reinforced toe cap — field-repaired multiple times
Thin compression socks under low-profile sneakers with thick gum soles
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 boundary. This is functional sub-grade assembly — built from salvage and discarded military/medical surplus, self-maintained, deliberately un-restored. The anti-reflective coating and BCI port suggest prior Tier 2-3 origins, but the current owner has stripped it of status markers and weaponized it for invisibility rather than display.
physical_description.cultural_context: Shelf runner, surveillance evader, or ungoverned zone operative. This is the uniform of someone who moves through contested corridors and GLMZ blind spots intentionally. The salvaged neural port and cargo clip suggest military or corporate security background (or theft thereof). Wearing this signals: 'I move unseen, I assemble my own gear, I know the gaps in the net.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Perpetually weathered and field-worn. Elbows thin at the fabric; sneakers held together by will and adhesive; hook-and-loop closures almost smooth from constant use. Nothing is pristine — every component shows its history. This is not a look that ages into vintage; it ages into function.
